title: PRII Federation Evidence Envelope (contract_version 1.0)
description: One normalized record as produced by federation/envelope.py's EvidenceEnvelope.to_dict(). This is the producer-internal envelope contract consumed by federation/export_writer.py and federation/validator.py — distinct from the hub-facing canonical package written by scripts/federation_export.py (see federation_source.schema.json et al. for that one). The sibling contract_version field this envelope ships under lives in the package manifest (manifest.json), not on the record itself; see validator.validate_manifest_contract_version.
